blocks.text: You can schedule an application's activity or inactivity reports for regular distribution to specified recipients. For example, you can schedule the Slack activity report for weekly distribution to your IT department and CIO.
Application reports provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Schedule reports for various criteria and distribute them to your choice of email recipients.
Frequently track application usage and take action for unused user licenses.

blocks.text: On the Application Reports page (Analytics > Reports > Business Insights Reports > Application Reports), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all configured scheduled reports. For each report, you can view:
Name: The name of the scheduled report.
Summary: A brief summary of the report. This is autogenerated based on the scheduled report.
Next Run: The date when the next report is scheduled to be generated.
Enable or disable the scheduled report.
